clips.send: Someone doubting themselves sends this to a friend who was told as a kid they weren't smart enough, as quiet vindication.
clips.caption:
Somewhere, a kid got told they were too dumb to do something. Most people carry that sentence into adulthood and never question it.

Kevin Trudeau's answer is a line from Henry Ford, one of the richest men who ever lived: if you believe you can, or if you believe you cannot, either way you are right.

It is not motivational-speaker fluff. Steve Jobs said it. Elon Musk says it. Warren Buffett's own partner, Charlie Munger, believed it until the day he died.

The thinking is what makes it true, in either direction.

Whose voice is still running in your head, and is it even yours?

#kevintrudeau #selfbelief #mindsetmatters #henryford #successhabits #overcomedoubt

clips.send: A trader sends this to a friend who trusts the Forbes list, pure anger at being lied to about who really runs the money.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the Forbes 400 list is not what it claims to be.

Two people arrested in Asia this year had crypto wallets worth $17 billion and $50 billion in cash, more than most names on that list. Neither of them made the cut.

As he puts it, quoting J. Paul Getty: it is not how much money you have, it is how much money you control. Norway's sovereign wealth fund alone holds $2 trillion. Saudi Arabia's holds $1.7 trillion. Almost nobody can name who actually controls either one.

The richest list you have ever seen might be missing its richest people.

#kevintrudeau #forbes400 #hiddenwealth #moneyexposed #wealthsecrets #richpeople

clips.send: Someone who just lost everything sends this to a friend who thinks it's over, as proof a comeback is still possible.
clips.caption:
A judge once told Kevin Trudeau he was giving him the longest sentence in American history for contempt of court: 10 years.

He lost everything. Every company he owned, shut down. Every penny, gone. Billions of dollars of enterprise, wiped out instantly.

His response was not panic. It was detachment. He says he was never that attached to material things in the first place.

Today, he says it is all coming back like crazy, because the same mind that built it once can build it again.

Could you stay that calm if you lost everything tomorrow?

#kevintrudeau #comebackstory #resilience #neverquit #successmindset #overcomeadversity
